aggregation_rules.baseline_dirty_paths: Exactly the main repository baseline_dirty_paths; the merged main-plus-external list belongs to submit time (see the submit_baseline operation).
aggregation_rules.changed_paths: Main changed_paths plus <root>/<path> for every external changed path; de-duplicated and sorted.
aggregation_rules.committed_paths: Main committed_paths plus <root>/<path> for every external committed path; de-duplicated and sorted.
aggregation_rules.git_policy_violations: Main codes verbatim plus <root>:<code> for every external code; de-duplicated and sorted.
aggregation_rules.head_before_head_after: Exactly the main repository values; per-repository HEADs live only in the repository entries.
aggregation_rules.repositories: Ordered list of per-repository entries; each entry is the repository result plus root and baseline_dirty_paths.
aggregation_rules.repository_order: The main workspace entry is always first; external repositories are sorted ascending by canonical root string (worker._collect_changes and git_snapshot.take_external_snapshots sort the same way).
aggregation_rules.scope_violations: Main scope_violations plus <root>/<path> for every external scope violation; de-duplicated and sorted.
aggregation_rules.task_changed_paths: Exactly the main workspace changed_paths (workspace-relative); external paths are never included.

cases.description: An old persisted single-repository result without a repositories key maps onto a one-entry list synthesized from the flat workspace fields, so structured consumers keep the same shape.
Compact task_status (verbose=false) surfaces the full repositories list when any repository has a scope or git-policy violation.
Compact task_status (verbose=false) omits the repositories key entirely when no repository has violations.
The snapshot declares the external repositories B then A: the aggregated repositories list keeps the main workspace first and sorts externals by canonical root string, so it becomes [main, A, B].
An external repository moved HEAD and its index without commit permission: the per-repository codes stay bare while the flat git_policy_violations qualifies each code as <root>:<code>.
Only an external repository changes: task_changed_paths stays empty (it is exactly the main workspace changed_paths) while changed_paths and committed_paths carry the qualified external paths.
An external repository is affected by allowed_paths but has no changes: it still gets a repository entry with empty lists while the flat lists equal the main workspace.

An external repository has a changed path outside its allowed scope: the per-repository scope violation stays repository-relative and is qualified with the external root in the flat scope_violations list.
The same relative path lib.py changes in both repositories: main stays workspace-relative while the external path is absolute-qualified, so the two never mix.

Each repository has its own changed_paths and committed_paths (the committed paths were pre-existing dirty baseline paths): the flat lists are the union of every repository's qualified paths while each repository entry keeps its repository-relative lists and its own baseline_dirty_paths.
Only the main workspace is affected: the aggregated result is the single main repository entry and every flat field equals it, with no external repository present.
One external repository is affected next to the main workspace: the external changed path is added to the flat changed_paths as an absolute-qualified path and appears as its own repository entry.

A dirty main workspace plus a dirty referenced external repository with allow_dirty=true: the submit result merges main-relative and root-qualified external dirty paths into one sorted baseline_dirty_paths list.

A configured trusted directory contains repository B, but no allowed path references B: only the referenced repository A is snapshotted, B's dirty baseline is ignored and B never reaches external_repositories or baseline_dirty_paths.
Two external repositories are affected: both are qualified and merged into the flat lists and both get their own repository entry after the main workspace.
Verbose task_status (verbose=true) always includes the full repositories list with every repository entry.

git_policy_violation_categories.external_repo_missing: Comparison-level missing_code returned by worker._repo_changes for an affected external repository whose directory is missing or is not a Git repository (the main workspace uses not_a_git_repo).
git_policy_violation_categories.head_changed: current_head != base_head while commit permission is not granted; for an external repository the flat list qualifies it as <root>:head_changed.
git_policy_violation_categories.history_rewritten: base_head is no longer an ancestor of current_head; reported regardless of commit permission and qualified as <root>:history_rewritten for external repositories.
git_policy_violation_categories.index_changed: The index fingerprint differs from the baseline while commit permission is not granted; qualified as <root>:index_changed for external repositories.

normalization_rules: Absolute roots, absolute-qualified paths, HEADs and fingerprints are placeholders; the corpus contains no machine-specific paths and no real hashes.
Flat lists are sorted lexicographically; because absolute-qualified external paths start with '/', they sort before workspace-relative paths.
Repository-relative paths inside repository entries stay literals so the qualification step is observable.
No secrets, request ids, task ids, timestamps or unstable identifiers appear in the corpus.

operations.aggregate_repositories: Compute worker._collect_changes for a task whose snapshot contains the declared repositories. Each repository input already carries the single-repository worker._repo_changes result (semantics defined in git-snapshot-fixtures.md); aggregation only qualifies and merges it. Expect the aggregated task result.
operations.submit_baseline: Reproduce submit_task_impl snapshot selection and baseline aggregation: only external repositories referenced by an absolute allowed path are snapshotted, sorted by canonical root; baseline_dirty_paths is the sorted union of the main-relative dirty paths and the root-qualified dirty paths of the referenced external repositories; without allow_dirty a non-empty union returns dirty_workspace.
operations.task_status_view: Persist the aggregated result of the referenced aggregate_repositories case and compute mcp_server._task_result with the declared verbose flag. A compact answer includes repositories only when at least one repository has scope or git-policy violations; a verbose answer always includes the full repositories list.

path_qualification.external: <root>/<path>, where root is the canonical absolute external repository root. External scope checks compare these qualified paths against that repository's absolute allowed entries and strip the prefix back to repository-relative for the repository entry.
path_qualification.main: Workspace-relative literals stay unchanged and are never absolute-qualified.

placeholder_conventions.${EXTERNAL_ROOT_A}: Absolute path of trusted external repository A; an opaque placeholder.
placeholder_conventions.${EXTERNAL_ROOT_B}: Absolute path of trusted external repository B; an opaque placeholder.
placeholder_conventions.${HEAD_EXT_A_AFTER}: External repository A HEAD after the task; opaque placeholder.
placeholder_conventions.${HEAD_EXT_A_BEFORE}: External repository A HEAD at snapshot time; opaque placeholder.
placeholder_conventions.${HEAD_EXT_B_AFTER}: External repository B HEAD after the task; opaque placeholder.
placeholder_conventions.${HEAD_EXT_B_BEFORE}: External repository B HEAD at snapshot time; opaque placeholder.
placeholder_conventions.${HEAD_MAIN_AFTER}: Main workspace HEAD after the task; opaque placeholder, equal to ${HEAD_MAIN_BEFORE} when HEAD did not move.
placeholder_conventions.${HEAD_MAIN_BEFORE}: Main workspace HEAD at snapshot time; opaque placeholder, never a real hash.
placeholder_conventions.${INDEX_FP_EXT_A_BEFORE}: External repository A index fingerprint at snapshot time.
placeholder_conventions.${INDEX_FP_EXT_B_BEFORE}: External repository B index fingerprint at snapshot time.
placeholder_conventions.${INDEX_FP_MAIN_BEFORE}: Main workspace index fingerprint at snapshot time (sha256 over git ls-files --stage and git ls-files -v).
placeholder_conventions.${MAIN_WORKSPACE}: Absolute path of the main Git workspace root; never a machine-specific literal.
placeholder_conventions.${TRUSTED_ROOT}: Absolute path of a configured trusted external directory that contains external repositories.

repository_input_dsl.allowed_paths: Normalized scope entries for this repository: workspace-relative for main, absolute-qualified for external.
repository_input_dsl.baseline: Before-snapshot fields: head, index_fingerprint and repository-relative dirty_paths, as in take_snapshot.
repository_input_dsl.derived_from: Reference(s) to git-snapshot-cases.json case ids whose single-repository semantics define the result shape; the mutations are not repeated here.
repository_input_dsl.result: The worker._repo_changes output for this repository: repository-relative changed_paths, committed_paths, scope_violations, git_policy_violations and head_before/head_after. This is a single-repository result, not recomputed here.
repository_input_dsl.role: main for the workspace repository, external for a trusted external repository.
repository_input_dsl.root: Canonical repository root placeholder: ${MAIN_WORKSPACE} or an external root placeholder.

view_rules.backward_compatibility: A persisted result without repositories maps to a one-entry list synthesized from the flat workspace fields by mcp_server._single_repository_view.
view_rules.compact: repositories is present only when mcp_server._has_repository_violations is true, i.e. some entry has non-empty scope_violations or git_policy_violations.
view_rules.verbose: repositories is always present with the full per-repository list.
